 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State of Rajasthan, Through PP.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Sharwan Singh Rathore, P.P. with  Mr. Ravindra Singh, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 12/11/2024

This application for bail under Section 483 BNSS (Section 439 Cr.P.C.) has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.0277/2022 registered at Police Station Begu, District Chittorgarh, for offences under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5(j), (2) (n) of POCSO Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that statements of victim "A" have already been recorded before competent criminal Court as PW-3.

Drawing attention of the Court towards statements of victim "A", learned counsel submitted that the Court [2024:RJ-JD:45701] (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-11960/2024] statements of the victim "A" clearly indicates that she remained in the company of present petitioner for more than one and a half year at various places, such as Ratlam,
Barodra, Neem Khera etc.

The victim was thus having ample opportunities of disclosing the factum Samrath vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:45701) on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176470175/
1 of she being forcibly abducted or subjected to sexual assault by the present petitioner, however, she did not do so.

entities.text: factum Samrath vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:45701)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel submitted that as a matter of fact, victim - "A" remained in the company of present petitioner for more that one and a half year out of her own free will and volition,
however, on relations between them turning strained, petitioner has been roped in a false criminal case.

Lastly, learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner is in judicial custody since 02.05.2024; the statements of the victim "A" have already been recorded before competent criminal Court and therefore, now, there is no apprehension of petitioner influencing her and other material prosecution witnesses or tampering with the evidence or fleeing away from justice, in case, he is enlarged on bail.

Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.
Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that statements of victim "A" has already been recorded before the competent criminal Court.

This Court also prima facie finds that [2024:RJ-JD:45701] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-11960/2024] victim "A"
has remained in the company of the present petitioner for more than one and a half year and despite having ample opportunities she did not disclosed the factum of she being abducted or subjected to forcible sexual assault by the present petitioner.

This Court also prima facie finds that prosecution has not shown any apprehension of petitioner influencing the other material witnesses of the case or fleeing away form justice, in case, he is enlarged on bail.
Thus, without expressing any opinion on merits/demerits of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 BNSS (Section 439 Cr.P.C.) is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused- petitioner Samrath S/o Kalu arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.0277/2022 registered at Police Station Begu, District Chittorgarh, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 79-AnilKC/-
